post.description:
Start an adaptive quiz on one topic at the chosen level (default medium).

Three correct answers in a row raise the next question's difficulty, two incorrect
in a row lower it (IT_14, ST_13). Every question carries the selected topic (ST_14).

get.description: The current difficulty, the question to answer now and the history so far.

post.description:
Answer the current question. The answer is scored and saved first; the response
says whether the difficulty was raised or lowered and carries the next question.

Ask the assistant to explain a concept or to generate a quiz on a topic.

*Explanation* (UT_17, ST_18): a simplified explanation with at least one example,
checked to be about the concept asked. *Quiz* (IT_17): a private practice quiz on
the named topic, ready to start with ``POST /ai/ask/{id}/start``. Its questions are
drafts that join no bank until approved on the review screen (S07.1). A blank query
is refused with "Please enter a question" and nothing is sent (UT_18).

*In a channel* (``channel_id``, S09.2): the answer is scoped to the channel's
subject and bank. A quiz uses the bank's peer questions first and generates only the
shortfall in the channel's subject (IT_18, ST_17); ``quiz.items`` marks each one
``peer`` or ``generated``. "Generate a quiz for this channel" uses the channel's
own topic.

403.description: Not a member of the channel

422.description: Blank query (Please enter a question) or no quiz topic

post.description:
Start the quiz generated by ``POST /ai/ask``; answer and submit it with the
usual ``/attempts/{id}`` routes. Only the requester can start it (404 otherwise).

post.description:
Generate 5-10 questions, each with options, a marked correct answer and an
explanation, for the selected subject, topic and difficulty (UT_13).

They are saved as drafts for the review screen and reach no bank or quiz until
approved (UT_14). A provider error or timeout returns 502/504 with a clear message.

get.description:
The review screen: every question with its review status, and whether Add to
Quiz is available yet.

put.description: Save a correction to a flawed question (IT_13). It stays pending until approved.

post.description: Approve a question: it joins the general or channel bank.
Reject a question: it is discarded and never appears in a bank or quiz (IT_13).

Add to Quiz: a draft quiz from the approved questions (publish it with
``POST /quizzes/{id}/publish``). Refused with 409 while any question is still
pending review (UT_14).

get.description:
My Quiz History: every submitted attempt with its score and timestamp (IT_11).

Attempts whose timer ran out are closed first, so they appear with the answers saved
before the limit. ``average_accuracy`` updates with each attempt (ST_12).

The attempt with its time left; reading it after the time limit auto-submits it
with the answers saved so far (ST_11) and returns the result.

put.description:
Save answers as the user goes, so they count if the timer runs out.

After the time limit nothing more is saved: the attempt is auto-submitted with
what was saved before it and the result is returned.

post.description:
Evaluate the written answers of the caller's submitted attempt (FR-08, S08.2).

Call it after submitting. Each descriptive answer is scored 0-10 with concept
feedback, as in ``POST /evaluations/descriptive``, and stored in the attempt: its
score is scaled to the question's points and added to the total, so
``GET /attempts/{id}`` and My Quiz History show it from then on. Objective marks
are never changed (NFR-06). Answers already evaluated are kept as they are, so
calling again only evaluates what is still pending. Someone else's attempt is a 404.

Submit the attempt and get the score straight away (UT_11).

Objective questions are scored deterministically, without the LLM. If questions
are unanswered the response names how many, e.g. "2 questions are unanswered"
(UT_12): under the ``warn`` rule submission waits for ``confirm: true`` (409 until
then); under ``block`` it is refused (422) until they are answered. Answers in the
request are saved either way. Once the time limit has passed the attempt is
auto-submitted regardless of the rule; only answered questions are scored and the
rest are marked unattempted (ST_11).

409.description: Unanswered questions under the "warn" rule: confirm to submit

Score a written answer 0-10 against the question's expected concepts (FR-08).

The feedback names each covered and missing concept and lists at least one
strength and one weakness. A blank answer is refused with "Answer cannot be empty"
(422) and nothing is sent to the LLM. Without a configured LLM, or if the LLM call
fails, the answer is scored by deterministic concept matching (``evaluator``).

get.description:
Search and filter materials (IT_07). Subject and topic together return only
materials matching both.

Without ``channel_id`` the search covers general materials and those in the
caller's channels; with it, that channel only, for its members. An empty result
carries ``empty_state`` for the UI.

post.description:
Upload a tagged study material (UT_07).

Subject, topic, semester and material type are all required; a blank one is refused
with its own message, e.g. ``Subject is required`` (UT_08). Files are checked for a
supported type and the size limit before anything is saved. A ``link`` material
carries a URL instead of a file. With ``channel_id`` the material is channel-scoped
and only that channel's members can see it.

Everything published in an Authorized Channel is official: only authorized users
may add it, and it is tagged ``Official/Verified`` (UT_05). ``is_official`` outside
an Authorized Channel is refused.

delete.description:
Remove a material (S03.1): it is no longer listed, shown or downloadable.

Same rule as editing: official content by its channel's authorized users (and
admins), peer content by its uploader; anyone else gets ``Insufficient permissions``.

get.description: One material with all its tags, file details and ratings.

patch.description:
Edit a material's details (S03.1).

Official content can be edited by the authorized users of its Authorized Channel
(and admins); a regular member gets **403** ``Insufficient permissions`` (UT_06).
Peer content can be edited by its uploader. The official tag cannot be changed.

get.description: The file as a download, under its original name (IT_08).

delete.description: Take back the caller's helpful mark.

put.description: Mark a material helpful (ST_07). Repeating it never adds more than one.

get.description: The file for viewing in the browser (IT_08): PDFs, images and text only.

post.description:
Report a material (for example "Duplicate content") to moderation (ST_08).

A reason is required. The report is recorded with its timestamp and reporter and
filed as open in the moderation queue, scoped to the material's channel. Reporting
the same material again while the first report is open returns that report.

put.description:
Rate a material 1-5 stars, optionally with review text (ST_07).

The response carries the updated ``rating_average``. Rating again replaces the
caller's earlier rating and review, so each user counts once. Uploaders cannot
rate their own material.

post.description:
Add a question with its subject, topic, difficulty and type tags (UT_09).

Submission is refused with "Please select the correct answer" when no correct
answer is given (UT_10). With ``channel_id`` it goes to that channel's bank, which
needs channel membership; without it, to the general bank. An Authorized Channel's
bank is official, so only its authorized users (and admins) add to it (S03.1).

put.description: Save the caller's 1-5 star rating (IT_09); rating again replaces it.

post.description:
Report a question (for example "Incorrect answer") to moderation (IT_09).

The report is logged as open in the moderation queue, scoped to the question's
channel so channel moderators see it. Reporting the same question again while the
first report is open returns that report instead of filing a duplicate.

post.description:
Save a quiz with the requested count, difficulty and timer (IT_10) as a draft
only its author can see.

With ``question_ids`` the reviewed set is saved as given (any published question
from the general bank or the ``channel_id`` bank, including one contributed a
moment ago, ST_10); without, the system picks matching questions. Publish it
with ``POST /quizzes/{id}/publish``.

Pick ``question_count`` matching bank questions for the author to review
before saving (use case Create Quiz, step 3). Nothing is saved.

Too few matching questions answers 409 with how many are available, so the client
can offer to broaden the criteria.

post.description:
Start the quiz; the timer starts now and ``remaining_seconds`` counts it down.

If the caller already has a running attempt at this quiz it is resumed (200) with
its answers and remaining time, so reloading the page does not restart the clock.
Non-members cannot attempt a channel quiz (403).
